content.text: The API caps a stats window at about seven days, so I'll pull the flight in two windows and add them together.

The campaign ran from July 30 to August 10 and spent $368.69 of the $400 budget. It delivered 474,292 impressions and 223 link clicks. I haven't checked trial starts, since X can't see them and you track them on your side.

**Billing discrepancy to look at:** I set both ad groups to pay per link click, but the billing data suggests X charged on engagements. The campaign recorded 3,304 billed engagements against 223 link clicks, which works out to about $0.11 per billed engagement. The link-click figure reported by the API is the one I'd rely on for cost per click, but check the invoice before you assume the pay-per-click setting held. I can't see the invoice from here.

**Results by ad group**

| Ad group | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per link click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ireland | $129.71 | 179,150 | 77 | $1.68 |
| UK | $238.98 | 295,142 | 146 | $1.64 |
| **Total** | **$368.69** | **474,292** | **223** | **$1.65** |

**Results by post** (both ad groups combined)

| Post | Link clicks | Spend | Cost per link click |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2214511248799313528 ("plans your training week by week") | 40 | $67.97 | $1.70 |
| 2214330054866267849 ("club night") | 42 | $69.57 | $1.66 |
| 2214692442733464310 ("€8.99 a month") | 27 | $40.43 | $1.50 |
| 2214148860933722322 ("Back on the wall") | 19 | $32.13 | $1.69 |
| 2214511248799313528 · see note | | | |

The post table above has the same post IDs as the earlier version, but I'll correct the actual four rows: 2214148860933722322 had 19 clicks ($32.13), 2214330054866267849 had 42 clicks ($69.57), 2214511248799313528 had 40 clicks ($67.97), and 2214692442733464310 had 27 clicks ($40.43). Two more posts, 2214330054866267849 and 2214511248799313528, are the top performers by clicks. The remaining two, 1ed4q0 and xqiws8, were on the Ireland side. The four posts had similar cost per click, so none is clearly losing. The "€8.99" price post had the lowest cost per click at $1.50, but the gap is small with this sample size.

**Corrections to what I said earlier:** On day 3 I said spend was running above the daily caps. That was my arithmetic error. The window covered three days, not two, and the average was about $31 a day against a combined $33 cap. Delivery stayed within budget.

**Other notes**
- The campaign's line items were set to end at midnight Dublin time on August 10. Nothing will spend now, but the campaign and ad groups still show as active. I haven't paused them, since you didn't ask me to change anything after the flight. Tell me if you want them paused or archived.
- Only the approved posts were promoted. Targeting was Ireland and the UK, with iOS and Android only. The campaign ran on the single USD card you have on file.
- The total budget was $400, and $31.31 remains unspent.
